title: 游戏玩大咯办不好摘下侍卫统领腰牌
content_zh:
游戏，玩大咯！
夕阳西下。
山间，绿木成林，鸟语天籁，芳香无处。
一座凉亭，一石墩，一壶清酒两清影，对弈其中。
御子尘手挽半袖，观棋盘，指尖一枚黑棋子，落棋难定，俊颜浮上愧色，眸如一泓清泉深澈，眼波流转间已辗转徘徊多回。最后，不禁脸色顿松，摇头失笑，“皇兄，臣弟又输了，皇兄这棋，交错纵横却又滴水不漏，可谓是步步为营，没有攻克的余地。”
酒醇气香，御圣君漆黑眼眸，仿若黑曜石，点缀着令人沉沦的醉意，甘愿为之倾倒。如同千年古玉的脸，无暇，微微透明，有一种冰冰凉的视觉感。唇角总是扬着一抹弧度，邪魅妖冶中有着慵懒之意。
一袭冷风而至，御子尘指尖所夹棋子落钵，倏然起身，眉峰皱拢，锐眸望向那绿林深处，猛喝：“护驾！”
御圣君仍闲适坐姿，但漆黑之眸，令人沉沦的醉意已消逝，鹰隼的眸光，射向那绿林深处。
随御子尘一声猛喝，数十锦衣护卫自周围地下树上现身，眨眼功夫，便都已外一圈，内一圈，护围了凉亭，长剑直抵地面。
倏然，数百支利箭从绿林深处陆续向凉亭发射而来，速度快得惊人。
御子尘袖手一挥，数十锦衣护卫同时甩剑，打落致命而来的利箭。剑箭相撞，数箭落地，未有一支箭能有机会穿入凉亭，直抵御圣君的心脏。
俄顷，一护卫手臂中箭倒地，口吐白沫死亡。
御圣君看那已死护卫一眼，眼神一冷，“咯吱”一声响，手中酒杯已被他捏碎，转瞬箭战结束，他松开手指，粉末自手掌掉于桌上，一阵微风拂过，吹掉了粉末，却吹不消粉末粘在手掌的白色印记。
周围的风，不再阴冷如前。
御子尘掠扫凉亭外面一眼，地上共躺着三具尸体，眼神不禁掠过一抹痛色，“从此，大内高手，又少了三个！”
御圣君眼中是捉摸不透的情绪，“回宫吧！”淡的比尘埃还轻的语气，却是充满磁性，略微沙哑的嗓音。
一会，大批锦衣护卫护送着一辆豪华马车，走在林间的大道上。
马车内，御圣君闭目养神，御子尘盯着某处，目光沉静。
队伍走了一段路程，一个画着迷彩脸，身穿迷彩服，戴着迷彩帽，背着胀鼓鼓迷彩包的高挑女子，右手拿着指南针，左手拽着胸前迷彩包的带子，向队伍迎面走来。
林间出了一打扮奇异的女子，引起了队伍的人好奇观望。

唐琳偏出队伍，从路旁背道走过，不时地望前方，再望望手上的指北针，识别方向。
马车在队伍中央。
马车内，御圣君睁开黑白分明的双眸，伸手撩起车帘，想看看外面的天色，一张迷彩脸映入了他的视野内，继而是唐琳全身映入他眼中，不禁怔愣住。
唐琳直走过，背对马车越来越远。
御圣君放下帘子，恢复原来的坐姿，那张迷彩脸，那身迷彩服，那个迷彩帽，那只迷彩包……占据了他的脑海，他已做不到闭目养神了。
队伍，已被唐琳远远地甩在身后，她站在路中间，望着前面那片绿林的深处，眼神不由得茫然了几分，“游戏，玩大咯！”
content_en:
Game, play big!
The sun sets.
In the mountains, there are forests of green trees, birds chirping, and fragrance everywhere.
A pavilion, a stone pier, a pot of sake and two clear shadows, playing chess among them.
Yu Zichen rolled up his half-sleeves and looked at the chessboard. There was a black chess piece at his fingertips. It was difficult to decide whether to place the chess piece. His handsome face was filled with shame. His eyes were as clear as a clear spring. His eyes had been wandering around many times. In the end, he couldn't help but relax his face, shook his head and laughed, "Brother Emperor, my brother has lost again. Brother Emperor's chess game is criss-crossed but watertight. It can be said that it is done step by step, and there is no room for victory."
The wine is mellow and fragrant, and the Royal Saint's dark eyes are like obsidian, dotted with intoxicating drunkenness, and he is willing to fall in love with it. Like the face of a thousand-year-old jade, it is flawless, slightly transparent, and has a cold visual sense. The corners of her lips are always curved, and there is a hint of laziness in her evil charm.
A cold wind came, and the chess piece held by Yu Zichen's fingertips fell into the bowl. He stood up suddenly, his eyebrows furrowed, his sharp eyes looked into the depths of the green forest, and he shouted: "Guard you!"
The Royal Saint is still sitting leisurely, but the intoxicating drunkenness in his dark eyes has disappeared, and the eyes of the falcon are shooting into the depths of the green forest.
Following Yu Zichen's fierce shout, dozens of guards in brocade robes appeared from the surrounding underground trees. In the blink of an eye, they were all surrounding the pavilion, with their long swords touching the ground.
Suddenly, hundreds of sharp arrows were fired towards the pavilion from the depths of the green forest at an alarming speed.
Yu Zichen waved his sleeves, and dozens of guards in brocade swung their swords at the same time, knocking down the deadly arrows. Swords and arrows collided, and several arrows fell to the ground. None of them had the chance to penetrate the pavilion and directly resist the heart of the Holy Lord.
A moment later, a guard fell to the ground with an arrow in his arm, foaming at the mouth and died.
The Royal Saint glanced at the dead guard, his eyes turned cold, and with a "crunch" sound, the wine glass in his hand was crushed by him. In an instant, the arrow battle was over. He released his fingers, and the powder fell from his palm on the table. A breeze blew by, blowing away the powder, but it could not remove the white mark that the powder stuck to his palm.
The surrounding wind is no longer as cold as before.
Yu Zichen glanced outside the pavilion and saw three corpses lying on the ground. A look of pain flashed across his eyes, "From now on, there are three less masters in the field!"
There was an unpredictable emotion in Yushengjun's eyes, "Go back to the palace!" The tone was lighter than dust, but it was full of magnetism and a slightly hoarse voice.
After a while, a large number of guards in brocade robes escorted a luxurious carriage on the forest road.
In the carriage, Yu Shengjun closed his eyes and rested, while Yu Zichen stared at something, his eyes calm.
The team walked for a while, and a tall woman with a camouflage face, camouflage uniforms, and a camouflage hat, carrying a bulging camouflage bag, walked towards the team with a compass in her right hand and the strap of the camouflage bag on her chest with her left hand.
A strangely dressed woman appeared in the forest, which aroused the curiosity of the people in the team.
Tang Lin deviated from the group and walked back to the roadside. From time to time she looked ahead and then looked at the compass in her hand to identify the direction.
The carriage was in the center of the procession.
In the carriage, Yu Shengjun opened his eyes with clear black and white eyes and reached out to lift the curtain to see the sky outside. A camouflage face came into his field of vision, and then Tang Lin's whole body came into his eyes. He couldn't help but be stunned.
Tang Lin walked straight past, her back to the carriage getting further and further away.
Yu Shengjun lowered the curtain and resumed his original sitting position. That camouflage face, that camouflage uniform, that camouflage hat, that camouflage bag... occupied his mind, and he could no longer close his eyes to rest.
The team was far behind Tang Lin. She stood in the middle of the road and looked into the depths of the green forest in front of her. Her eyes couldn't help but be a little dazed, "Let's play the game!"
